name: Ookami Shoujo Reona -Yasei Houkai Hakuchi Kyouiku-
original_name: オオカミ少女レオナ－野性崩壊白痴狂育－
source:
One day, the main character finds a journal of his parents that he lost in an accident.
There he finds a mysterious phrase..."Our daughter is still in the jungle."
Following the inscription, he finds his little sister, fed by wolves in a jungle!

Will she start a new life as a human, or continue to live as an animal?
It's all up to you! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE055083.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角发现了一本在事故中丢失的父母日记。
在那里他发现了一个神秘的短语……“我们的女儿仍在丛林中。”
顺着铭文，他找到了在丛林中被狼喂食的妹妹！

她会以人类的身份开始新的生活，还是继续以动物的身份生活？
这一切都取决于你！

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE055083.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
